blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一种完全在纹理空间为三维物体生成高质量材料的方法。 我们微调一个视频传播变压器,用于文本制导材料生成,多视图材料生成,材料提升. 我们的关键见解是利用从图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影,使扩散过程能够将任意的地美和纹理参数化概括起来. 这种方法还避免了视频和多视图传播模式所固有的观点一致性问题. 因为纹理空间是二维的,我们可以再利用预先训练的视频传播模型的强前奏. 我们采用我们的方法来进行高质量的材料重建,从不明光线下拍摄的所展示的照片,以及文字和图像指导材料的生成。 我们的方法可以放大到高分辨率(8K),100+输入视图,以及神经物质表达. 在定量和定性评价中,我们显示了材料生成和重建的最新成果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In this work, we focus on the task of generating realistic materials for 3D objects from text descriptions and/or photographs.
A common way of representing realistic materials for a 3D object is storing the spatially varying material
parameters in texture maps.
This is the standard approach for materials in 3D graphics systems, e.g., Blender and Unreal Engine. However, authoring detailed materials on complex 3D assets is a labor-intensive task.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们侧重于从文字描述和/或相片中为3D对象生成现实材料的任务.
对三维物体来说,一种代表现实材料的共同方法是储存空间相异的材料。

这是三维图形系统中的材料的标准方法,例如Blender和不真实引擎. 然而,撰写关于复杂三维资产的详细材料是一项劳动密集型的任务。

blocks.en: Recent advances in generative modeling have made it increasingly practical to synthesize 3D geometry and appearance from text or images. Existing approaches broadly fall into two categories: image-space and object-space models.
blocks.zh: 最近基因模型化的进步使得从文字或图像中合成3D几何和外观变得日益实用. 现有方法大致分为两类:图像空间和物体空间模型。

blocks.en:
Image-space methods ( Poole et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024d ; Youwang et al., 2024 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ; Hasselgren et al., 2026 ) build on image or video generative models to produce multiple views of an object,
from which geometry and materials are reconstructed using optimization through differentiable rendering.
They are mainly limited by view consistency: the same surface point may be predicted differently across generated
views, often leading to reduced details, suppressed specular highlights or blurred textures.
blocks.zh:
图像空间方法 (Poole等,2023年;Deng等,2024年;Zhang等,2024年d;Youwang等,2024年;Munkberg等,2025年;Hasselgren等,2026年) 以图像或视频基因模型为基础,对物体产生多种观点,
通过可分辨的渲染,利用优化来从中重建几何和材料.
它们主要受到观点一致性的限制:对生成的同一地表点的预测可能有所不同。
视图,往往导致细节减少,被压制的光谱突出或纹理模糊.

blocks.en:
Object-space methods ( Xiang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ) instead rely on three-dimensional representations such as sparse voxel grids or triplanes.
Because features are attached to fixed locations, these methods avoid view-consistency issues.
However, sparse 3D representations are memory- and compute-intensive, require specialized complex architectures, and are
trained from scratch on synthetic data rather than leveraging the priors of large video foundation models, which may lead to lower visual quality.
blocks.zh:
对象-空间方法(Xiang等,2026;He等,2025;Wu等,2025;Yu等,2024;Li等,2026a;Li等,2026b等)取而代之的是三维表示法,如稀疏的花纹网格或出行纹.
由于特征被附在固定位置上,这些方法避免了取景一致性问题.
然而,很少的3D表示是内存和计算密集型的,需要专门的复杂架构,而且
从零开始接受合成数据培训,而不是利用大型视频基础模型的前科,这可能导致视觉质量下降。

blocks.en:
In this work,
inspired by TEXGen ( Yu et al., 2024 ) ,
we explore the texture space domain for high quality material generation.
Texture space is two-dimensional, allowing us to easily adapt existing image and video models, and is view consistent by design.
In Figure 2 , we illustrate the concept of texture mapping, and the projection from views back into texture space.
Our main target application is material estimation for a known, scanned, object
with uncontrolled lighting.
Each view is projected into a shared UV atlas, and a generative video model is conditioned
on the shaded texture space views, generating output frames with the physically-based rendering (PBR) material parameters: ( basecolor , height , roughness , metalness ).

blocks.en:
We show that our method can be made robust to inconsistencies in both input views and geometry, making it a versatile component
in larger content-generation pipelines. The input views can include high quality photos from a controlled setup, phone captures, or even views generated by a (e.g. depth-conditioned) video model. The geometry can be an accurate scan, or a coarser extraction from recent image-conditioned models ( Li et al., 2026b ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们显示,我们的方法可以强大到 输入观点和几何学的不一致, 使它成为一个多功能的组成部分
在更大的内容生成管道。 输入视图可以包括来自受控设置的高质量相片,手机捕捉,甚至可以由(如有深度条件的)视频模型所生成的相片. 几何可以是准确的扫描,也可以是从最近图像条件模型中取出相近的相近相(Li等,2026b;Xiang等,2026;Team等,2026).

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Texture Space Observations. We leverage known geometry with a non-overlapping texture parameterization.
Given camera poses and geometry, we project each view back into texture space, which results in partially covered texture space observations. By formulating our diffusion process in the 2D texture space domain, we can leverage powerful image- and video diffusion model priors to synthesize high quality materials.
blocks.zh:
图2:纹理空间观测。 我们用非重叠的纹理参数来利用已知的几何学。
鉴于相机的姿势和几何特征,我们把每个视图都投放回了纹理空间,从而导致部分覆盖了纹理空间观测. 通过在2D纹理空间领域制定我们的传播过程,我们可以利用强大的图像和视频传播模型前身来合成高品质的材料.

blocks.en:
We complement our multi-view to material model with a generative upscaler trained on UV-atlases of material parameters, which, combined with inference time augmentation,
can be used to scale to both higher resolution (8K) and more input views (100+) than used in training.
Finally, we show that text-conditioned and single-image conditioned material generations are feasible in texture space by finetuning a diffusion transformer model with a novel 3D-aware rotary positional embedding which encodes the (per-texel) world space position and frame ID. Our main contributions are:

我们用一个经过铀原子物质参数培训的分基因升级器来补充我们对材料模型的多视角,结合推论时间增强,
可用于比起培训中所使用的更高的分辨率(8K)和更多的输入视图(100+).
最后,我们表明,文字条件和单一图像条件的材料代代在纹理空间是可行的,方法是用一种新颖的3D-意识回转位置嵌入来微调一个扩散变压器模型,它编码(每特克塞尔)世界空间位置和框架ID。 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • To our knowledge, the first diffusion framework that generates complete PBR materials entirely in texture space, combining a view-consistent 2D representation with pretrained image and video priors. • We show that full texture-space generation enables robust material reconstruction under unknown lighting from single or multiple views. • Training-free noise rolling and coverage-aware expert aggregation scale inference to 8K textures and over 100 input views.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Method Overview. Our pipeline leverages diffusion transformers in texture space to synthesize
high quality materials. We support multiple input modalities: 1) one or more views projected into texture space, which can be photographs, rendered images, or frames generated by diffusion models 2) a text prompt describing the material
3) low-resolution material maps. In all cases, we condition the model on world space positions, normals and a text prompt.
Our finetuned DiT successfully demodulates the (unknown) lighting, and creates clean albedo, roughness, and metallicity maps with high frequency details.
The materials can be directly applied in standard content creation tools.
blocks.zh:
图3:方法概览。 我们的管道在纹理空间利用扩散变压器合成
高质量材料。 我们支持多种投入模式: 1) 投射到纹理空间的一个或多个视图,可以是相片,制成相片,也可以是传播模型生成的相框 2) 一个文字提示来描述材料
3)低分辨率材料地图. 在所有情况下,我们把模型设定在世界空间位置、正常状态和文字提示上。
我们的微调DiT成功降级了(未知的)照明,并制作了具有高频细节的清洁反照率,粗糙度和金属度图.
这些材料可以被直接应用于标准内容创建工具.

blocks.en:
Image diffusion models generate samples through iterative denoising ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) .
Video diffusion models ( Blattmann et al., 2023b ; Blattmann et al., 2023a ; Hong et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; NVIDIA, 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) extend this concept to the temporal domain.
Diffusion transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) have become a common
architecture due to their performance and flexible finetuning opportunities.
In this work, we build upon the DiT-based Wan 2.1 model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and use its temporal
representation to process multi-view observations and produce multiple modalities.
blocks.zh:
图像传播模型通过迭代去诺来生成样本(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015;Ho等,2020;Dhariwal和Nichol,2021).
视频传播模型(Blatmann等,2023b;Blatmann等,2023a;Hong等,2023;Yang等,2025b;NVIDIA,2025;Wan等,2025)将这一概念扩展到了时间域.
分流变压器(DiTs)(Peebles和Xie,2023年)已成常见.
由于其性能和灵活的微调机会。
在这项工作中,我们利用基于DiT的Wan 2.1模型(Wan等人,2025年),并使用其时间。
用于处理多视图观察并产生多种模式。

blocks.en:
Many methods build on image diffusion models with score distillation sampling (SDS) to produce complete 3D assets ( Poole et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024a ) .
SDS-based methods require slow optimization, prompting the development of methods that reconstruct in a single forward pass using a pretrained transformer ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh:
许多方法基于带有分数分馏取样的图像传播模型,以产生完整的3D资产(Poole等,2023;Zhu等,2024a; Wang等, 2023; Zhu等, 2024a.).
以SDS为基础的方法需要缓慢地优化,促使采用事先经过训练的变压器在一次前行后重建的方法得到发展(Li等,2024;Zhang等,2024a.) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en:
A common limitation of image models is the lack of view consistency, which may show up as blur in the extracted textures.
Multi-view diffusion models e.g., MVDream ( Shi et al., 2024 ) address this by jointly generating images from several
canonical viewpoints.
SV3D ( Voleti et al., 2024 ) and Hi3D ( Yang et al., 2024 ) further improve on this aspect by finetuning video diffusion models for object rotations, and extract 3D models from the generated views. However, these approaches have limited resolution and do not provide Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials.
blocks.zh:
对图像模型的一个共同限制是缺乏取景一致性,在被取取取的纹理中可能显示为模糊.
MVDream(Shi等,2024年)等多视图传播模型通过联合生成几个图像来解决这一问题。
(原始内容存档于2012-10-10). Canonical views.
SV3D(Voleti等,2024年)和Hi3D(Yang等,2024年)通过微调物体自转的视频传播模型,从所生成的视图中提取出3D模型,从而进一步改善了这一方面. 然而,这些方法的分辨率有限,不能提供物理成像材料。

blocks.en:
Another direction is to apply the generative process in 3D space, which is view-consistent by design.
3DTopia-XL ( Chen et al., 2025b ) and Trellis ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) encode the 3D shape, textures, and materials in volumetric primitives anchored and jointly generates shape and PBR materials. Recently, LSRM ( Li et al., 2026b ) leverages sparse attention to extend this approach to higher resolutions.
These methods target complete asset generation, whereas we focus on
PBR materials.
blocks.zh:
另一个方向是将基因过程应用到3D空间中,通过设计实现取景一致性.
3DTopia-XL (Chen等, 2025b)和Trellis (Xiang等, 2025; Xiang等, 2026)将3D外形,纹理,和质地原始物中的材料固定并联合生成外形和PBR材料. 最近,LSRM(Li等人,2026年b)利用很少的注意力将这种方法推广到更高的分辨率.
这些方法的目标是完整的资产产生,而我们的重点是
PBR材料.

blocks.en:
Material reconstruction is commonly formulated as an inverse-rendering
problem from dense set of inputs.
Differentiable rasterization ( Laine et al., 2020 ) has been successfully applied to photogrammetry ( Munkberg et al., 2022 ) .
Differentiable path tracing ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Jakob et al., 2022 ) accurately simulates global
illumination effects, and has higher potential reconstruction quality ( Hasselgren et al., 2022 ) , but introduces Monte-Carlo noise in the training process, which makes gradient-based optimization more challenging.
Volumetric scene representations such as NeRFs ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ) and
Gaussian splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) provide a smoother optimization landscape with impressive novel-view synthesis quality, but disentangling shape, materials, and lighting is non-trivial.
blocks.zh:
材料重建通常被表述为反向倒置
由密集的一组输入产生的问题。
可分化光栅化(Laine等,2020年)已成功应用于摄影测量(Munkberg等,2022年).
可分道扬镳的路径追踪(Zhang等,2020;Jakob等,2022)准确模拟了全球.
照明效应,具有较高的潜在重建质量(Hasselgren等,2022年),但在培训过程中引入了蒙特-卡洛噪声,这使得以梯度为基础的优化更具挑战性.
NERFs(Mildenhall等,2020年)和
高斯克平板(Kerbl等,2023年)提供了较为平滑的优化地貌,具有令人印象深刻的小说-视觉合成质量,但分化出外形,材料,照明是非三角的.

blocks.en:
A closely related line of research is intrinsic decomposition of images, including per-pixel material parameter estimation from sparse set of inputs.
To account for the decomposition ambiguity, recent methods use image or video diffusion models to generate materials ( Kocsis et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2024b ; Zhu et al., 2024b ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Ying et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) and potentially combine with optimization-based inverse rendering ( Kocsis et al., 2026 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
一个紧密相联的研究线是图像的内在分解,包括从稀有的一组投入中得出的每像素材料参数估计.
为了解释分解的模糊性,最近的方法使用图像或视频传播模型来生成材料(Kocsis等人,2024;Chen等人,2024;Zeng等人,2024; 2024b; 朱等; 2024b; 梁等; 2025; 殷等; 2025; 曾等; 2026; 罗等; 2026; 有潜力与基于优化的反向渲染相结合(Kocsis等; 2026; Munkberg等; 2025.).

blocks.en:
Recent works leverage diffusion models for generating more expressive neural materials on 2D patches ( Raghavan et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) , on 3D geometry ( Yu et al., 2026 ) or to extract neural materials from images ( Youwang et al., 2026 ) .
These methods are operating in image-space, while we propose to directly generate in texture space.
While we focus on PBR materials in this paper, neural materials are an exciting future direction, and we include a proof-of-concept example.
blocks.zh:
近期作品利用传播模型在2D补丁上生成更多表达性神经材料(Raghavan等,2025;薛等,2026),3D几何上生成(Yu等,2026)或从图像上提取神经材料(Youwang等,2026).
这些方法在图像空间中运行,同时我们提议在纹理空间中直接生成.
我们在本文中关注PBR材料的同时,神经材料是一个令人振奋的未来方向,我们包含了一个概念证明的例子.

blocks.en:
Earlier approaches formulate the task of material generation as retrieval or interpolation of a database of known
high-quality materials or material graphs, and learn to project the input (image or text) onto the known representation ( Zhang et al., 2024c ; Ceylan et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) .
These methods are limited by the expressiveness of their material databases, but are well-regularized.
blocks.zh:
早期方法规定了材料生成的任务,即检索或插入已知的数据库。
高质量的材料或材料图表,并学会将输入(图像或文字)投射到已知的表示(张等,2024c;Ceylan等,2024;Fang等,2024.).
这些方法因其材料数据库的表达性而受到限制,但规范性很强.

blocks.en:
Hybrid approaches combine image diffusion models with material distillation using inpainting, or coarse-to-fine texture refinement ( Richardson et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2024a ; Youwang et al., 2024 ; Hadadan et al., 2025 ) .
Recent methods fine-tune the diffusion model to condition on geometry or lighting ( Zhang et al., 2024d ; Deng et al., 2024 ) or even to directly generate the intrinsic properties from text or known geometry ( Kocsis et al., 2025 ; Munkberg et al., 2025 ; Hasselgren et al., 2026 ) .
CLAY’s ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) material generation model uses a finetuned multi-view image diffusion model ( Shi et al., 2024 ) conditioned on normal maps. The material model generates four canonical views of the PBR texture maps, which are then projected into texture space. Several recent methods ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Boss et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Engelhardt et al., 2025 ; Seed, 2025 ) extend this approach with additional input conditioning (normal, depth and/or world space positions).
However, these methods operate in image space, potentially leading to texture seams and limited resolution.
blocks.zh:
混合方法将图像传播模型与材料蒸馏相结合,使用涂料,或粗到细的纹理精炼(Richardson等,2023;Chen等,2023;Zeng等,2024a;Youwang等,2024;Hadadan等,2025)。
近代方法将扩散模型微调为以几何或照明为条件(Zhang等,2024d;Deng等,2024),甚至直接从文字或已知几何学中产生内在属性(Kocsis等,2025;Munkberg等,2025;Hasselgren等,2026).
CLAY's(张等,2024b.) 材料生成模型使用以普通地图为条件的微调多视图图像传播模型(Shi等,2024. 材料模型生成了PBR纹理图的4个相克视图,后被投射入纹理空间. 最近的几种方法(黄等,2025;冯等,2025;Boss等,2025;He等,2025;Shao等,2025;Yang等,2025a;Engelhardt等,2025;种子,2025)将这一方法扩大,增加了投入条件(正常、深度和/或世界空间位置)。
然而,这些方法在图像空间中运作,有可能导致纹理接合和分辨率有限.

blocks.en:
TEXGen ( Yu et al., 2024 ) shows that it is possible to directly generate in texture space.
To provide geometry information, they interleave convolutions in texture space with attention layers on point clouds to outpaint diffuse textures.
Inspired by this, we formulate the generation process entirely in texture space that can generate complete PBR materials.
blocks.zh:
TEXGen(Yu等,2024年)表明,在纹理空间中直接生成是可能的.
为了提供几何信息,它们在纹理空间中与点云的注意力层相交,以出彩散纹理.
受此启发,我们完全在能生成完整的PBR材料的纹理空间中制定生成过程.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our texture space diffusion method, as shown in Figure 3 , predicts physically-based rendering (PBR) material textures ( Burley, 2012 ; Karis, 2013 ) from
posed views. We assume a given 3D model with a valid texture parameterization (but no textures) as input, alongside a text prompt describing the material. Our approach is multi-modal, and can predict
materials from: 1) one or multiple posed views, 2) a text prompt, or 3) low-resolution material maps.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,我们的纹理空间扩散方法预测物理渲染(PBR)物质纹理(Burley,2012;Karis,2013)。
提出看法。 我们假设一个带有有效纹理参数化(但没有纹理)的给定3D模型作为输入,同时有一个文字提示来描述材料. 我们的方法是多种模式,可以预测
1) 一种或多种观点;2) 文字提示;3) 低分辨率材料地图。

blocks.en:
Given known camera parameters and geometry, we project the views into texture space and formulate
the diffusion process in texture space, leveraging pre-trained 2D diffusion priors (e.g., a video diffusion model).
One can see our approach as a texture completion task, conditioned on world space positions, normals, and a text prompt. Our finetuned model outputs two images, representing the
PBR material maps in texture space, one for base color and the other encoding a height map, roughness, and metallicity combined into an RGB image.
We use the height map only for surface normal perturbation (bump mapping), but it could also be used for displacement mapping.
blocks.zh:
根据已知的相机参数和几何图形,我们把观测结果投射到纹理空间,并形成
在纹理空间的传播过程,利用预先训练的2D传播前科(如视频传播模型).
人们可以将我们的方法视为一项纹理完成任务,以世界空间位置、正常情况以及文字提示为条件。 我们的微调模型输出两个图像,代表
PBR 在纹理空间中的材料地图,一个用于基色,另一个用于编码一个高地图,粗糙度,和金属度结合成一个RGB图像.
我们只使用高地图来进行地表平地扰动(bump maging),但也可以用于迁移地图.

blocks.en:
The task is to merge a set of sparse texture space (shaded) views into dense,
fully covered texture space material maps. The model needs to learn how to demodulate lighting from the
texture space views, merge the observations, and hallucinate plausible detail in regions with missing coverage.
Here, 𝐈 \mathbf{I} consists of N = 17 N=17 texture space views,
with spatial resolution H × W H\times W . These are encoded using ℰ \mathcal{E} into a latent tensor, z 𝐈 \textbf{z}^{\mathbf{I}} .

完全覆盖的纹理空间材料地图。 该模型需要学习如何将照明从
纹理空间观察, 合并观测, 并产生幻觉 可能的细节 在覆盖缺失的区域。
在这里, I\ mathbf{I} 由 N = 17 N = 17 纹理空间视图组成,
带有空间分辨率 H × W H\times W 。 这些代码使用 E\ mathcal{ E} 编码成一个潜在的收音机, z I\ textb{tz}^{\mathb{ I} 。

blocks.en:
Our training data consists of path traced views of 3D models.
However, real captures and current video diffusion models come with view-inconsistencies.
To make our model more robust, we augment the training data with random corruptions of the input views.
First, we create a version of the dataset where we add Gaussian noise to the views and denoise them with
FLUX.1-dev ( Labs, 2024 ) img2img (using strength ∈ [ 0 , 0.3 ] \in[0,0.3] , guidance scale ∈ [ 0 , 3.0 ] \in[0,3.0] and 20 denoising steps).
Secondly, we add Gaussian blur with randomized σ ∈ [ 0 , 15 ] \sigma\in[0,15] to the input views during training.
These augmentations encourage our material extraction model to be robust to imperfections, while still producing high frequency details.
blocks.zh:
我们的训练数据包括3D模型的路径跟踪视图.
然而,真实的捕捉和目前的视频传播模型都带有取景不一致.
为了使我们的模型更加坚固,我们通过对输入观点的随机腐败来增加培训数据。
首先,我们创建一个版本的数据集,在这个版本中,我们将高斯噪音加到视图中,并用
FLUX.1-dev (Labs, 2024) img2img (使用强度 [0, 0.3]\ in [0, 0.3], 指向尺度 [0, 3.0]\ in [0, 3.0] 和20个去名步骤).
第二,我们在训练期间的输入视图中加入带有随机化"\\\\\\\\\\[0,15]\\sigma\in[0,15]的高斯模糊度.
这些增量鼓励我们的材料提取模型坚固到不完善,同时仍然产生高频细节.

blocks.en:
In this setting, we only have a single observation of the materials in a shaded view, which we project into texture space. The model, guided by the texture space sparse input and conditions, needs to demodulate lighting and inpaint plausible details in missing regions. Here 𝐈 \mathbf{I} consists of a single, sparse texture space view.
To improve consistency of the generated material, inspired by RomanTex ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , we introduce a novel 3D-aware rotary positional embedding (RoPE), combining the frame ID and world space position.
To our knowledge, we are the first to apply a 3D-aware RoPE in texture space.
Encoding world space positions directly in RoPE supplies a stronger or more direct geometric bias than G-buffer conditioning alone, improving attention in spatially adjacent surface regions that are distant in texture space.
In our supplemental material, we ablate the impact of this 3D-aware RoPE.
blocks.zh:
在这个背景下,我们只能对阴影视野中的材料进行单一的观测,我们将其投射入纹理空间. 该模型以纹理空间稀少的投入和条件为指导,需要在缺失区域降级照明和涂抹合理细节。 在这里, I\ mathbf{I} 包含一个单一的, 稀少的纹理空间视图 。
为了提高所生成材料的一致性,受RomanTex(冯等,2025年)的启发,我们引入了一款小说"3D-意识回转位置嵌入"(ROPE),将帧ID和世界空间位置结合起来.
据我们所知,我们第一个在纹理空间应用了3D-意识的RoPE.
直接在ROPE中编码世界空间位置,提供比光是G-缓冲调节更强或更直接的几何偏差,提高地表空间相邻地表区域在纹理空间相去遥远的注意力.
在我们的补充材料中,我们减轻了这种3D-意识的ROPE的影响.

blocks.en:
The text to material model is near identical to the single-view model.
We replace 𝐈 \mathbf{I} with a binary UV coverage mask, indicating which parts of texture space are populated or empty,
and use the same 3D-aware RoPE.
blocks.zh:
文本到材料模型与单景模型几乎完全相同.
我们用二进制紫外线覆盖口罩替换 I\mathbf{I}, 显示纹理空间的哪些部分是被覆盖或空的,
并使用相同的3D-意识 RoPE.

blocks.en:
To increase the resolution of the generated material maps, we propose a texture-space generative refinement model. This model is primarily useful to complement the multi-view to material generation method of Section 3.1 .
The upscaler model is similar to the single-view to material model, but with the single frame replaced with two low resolution PBR material maps (with full coverage). In training, the low resolution PBR material guides are generated by first downscaling then upscaling the reference materials with area weighted or nearest neighbor filtering (randomly selected) using the scaling factors: 2,4,8, and 16.
blocks.zh:
为了提高生成的材料地图的分辨率,我们提出了一个纹理-空间基因改良模型。 这一模式主要有助于补充第3.1节材料生成方法的多视角。
升降机模型与材料模型的单视相类似,但单相框被两个低分辨率的PBR材料地图所取而代之(全覆盖了). 在培训中,低分辨率的PBR材料指南是通过先缩小尺度,再利用2、4、8和16等比例系数,将参考材料升级为加权区域或最近邻国的过滤(随机选定)。

The above methods can be extended to handle neural material representations by replacing the target latent variable, z 0 𝐦𝐚𝐭 \textbf{z}_{0}^{\mathbf{mat}} (which consists of encoded PBR material maps), with VAE-encoded neural material textures.
As a proof of concept, we apply the dataset and neural material representation of Yu et al. (2026) to our generative
image-conditioned model. Neural representations can be used to encode more complex appearances, such as the fuzzy material shown in our result in the right column of Figure 1 .

作为概念的证明,我们把Yu等人(2026年)的数据集和神经物质表现应用到我们的基因中.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训数据集

blocks.en:
Our dataset consists of 120k videos of object-centric renderings of 3D models from TexVerse ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
For each object, we render a video with 17 frames at a resolution of 2048 × \times 2048, using a path tracer with three bounces, black background and Blender AgX tonemapping.
For lighting, we use 697 light probes from Poly Haven ( Poly Haven, ) , one randomly selected for each object.
Each frame is projected into texture space following Figure 2 .
We automatically generate captions using Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) .
We also rasterize intrinsic conditioning guides (world space positions and world space normals) directly in texture space and store them alongside reference base color, roughness, metallicity and height textures.
The height map is not available for most assets, and we reconstruct it from the normal map using standard conversion tools.
blocks.zh:
我国数据集由TexVerse(张等,2025年)的以物体为中心的三维模型渲染的120k个视频组成.
对于每个物体,我们用2048×\times 2048的分辨率制作一个17帧的视频,使用一个路径追踪器,有3个回弹,黑色背景和Blender AgX音调图.
在照明方面,我们使用来自Poly Haven(Poly Haven,)的697个光探测器,每个物体随机选择一个.
每个框架按照图2预测为纹理空间。
我们使用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Quen Team,2024)自动生成字幕.
我们还将内在的调节导线(世界空间位置和世界空间常态)直接放入纹理空间,与参考底色、粗糙度、金属和高地纹相并存。
对于大多数资产来说,高度图是没有的,我们用标准转换工具从普通地图上重建.

blocks.en: 3.3 Inference Scaling
blocks.zh: 3.3 推论扩展

blocks.en: Scaling transformer models to higher resolution or more input views is challenging due to attention cost. We show that inference-time methods can enable scaling beyond the training domain.
blocks.zh: 由于注意成本,将变压器模型放大到更高分辨率或更多输入视图具有挑战性。 我们显示,推论时间方法能够使规模超越培训领域。

blocks.en:
Our high-resolution inference uses progressive noise rolling, inspired by Bar-Tal et al. (2023) ; Vecchio et al. (2024) .
We first run inference on the original 2K resolution. We upscale the resulting image to 8K, add a small amount of noise, and resume denoising from that point.
In each diffusion step, we split all model inputs ( z τ 𝐦𝐚𝐭 , z 𝐈 , z c \textbf{z}_{\tau}^{\mathbf{mat}},\textbf{z}^{\mathbf{I}},\textbf{z}^{\textbf{c}} ) into non-overlapping 2K crops, evaluate 𝐟 θ \mathbf{f}_{\theta} on each crop, and stitch the result
together. We hide seams by applying a random spatial roll in each diffusion step, thus randomly offsetting the crops.
We apply noise rolling in the upscaling step for best runtime performance.
blocks.zh:
我们的高分辨率推论使用渐进式噪声滚动,灵感来自Bar-Tal等人(2023年);Vecchio等人(2024年).
我们首先对原来的2K决议进行推论. 我们把产生的图像放大到8K, 增加少量的噪音,然后从那个点恢复去诺.
在每一个推广步骤中,我们将所有模型输入(z \ mat , z I, z c\ textb{ tau}^{\ mathbf{ mat}},\ textb{ s}^{\ mathbf{ I}},\textb{ textbf{ c}}) 分成非重叠的 2K 作物, 在每个作物上评价 f\ mathb{ f}_{\theta} 并缝合结果 。
一起来 我们通过在每一个扩散步骤中应用随机空间卷来隐藏接合物,从而随机地抵消作物.
我们在升级步骤中应用滚动的噪音来达到最佳运行时的性能.

blocks.en:
To use more input observations, we evaluate them batch-wise and propose a fusing strategy.
We split the input views into overlapping batches.
In each denoising step, we predict the flow for all batches, given the same noisy latents, referred to as expert predictions.
To aggregate the predictions, we compute per-texel coverage scores for all experts.
These coverage maps can act as an uncertainty-measure, i.e. more views observe a texel, the more certain the prediction should be.
For each texel, we keep the top-2 expert predictions and use their coverage-weighted average.
This retains redundancy, while avoiding the oversmoothing that would result from averaging all experts.
blocks.zh:
为了使用更多的输入观测数据,我们分批评估,并提出引信战略。
我们把输入视图分成相重叠的批次。
在每一个消音步骤中,我们预测所有批次的流量,考虑到同样的噪音潜伏,称为专家预测。
为了汇总预测,我们计算出所有专家的每吨覆盖率。
这些覆盖图可以起到不确定性度量的作用,即观测到一德克塞尔的视角越多,预测就越有把握.
对于每台德克塞尔,我们保留了前2位专家的预测,并使用其覆盖加权平均值.
这保留了冗余,同时避免了因平均所有专家而导致的过度波动。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate our method against the state-of-the-art in multi-view to material reconstruction and text/image conditioned material generation. Additionally, we ablate robustness to view- and geometry inconsistencies, and our inference-time methods for increasing the number of input views and resolution. For quantitative results we use a synthetic dataset of 32 held out 3D models from the BlenderVault dataset ( Litman et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们在对材料重建和文字/图像有条件的材料生成的多视角中,对照最先进的方法来评价我们的方法。 此外,我们降低强度,消除取景和几何不一致之处,并采用推论时间方法来增加投入观点和解析度。 对于定量结果,我们使用BlenderVault数据集(Litman等,2025年)中32个3D模型的合成数据集。

blocks.en: 4.1 Multi-view to materials
blocks.zh: 4.1 对材料的多视角

blocks.en:
We evaluate our multi-view material reconstruction model on two test sets: 1) A fully controlled synthetic test set with 32 examples 2) Eight real multi-view captures from the DTC ( Dong et al., 2025 ) dataset.
For the synthetic set, we render each 3D model with extracted materials from eight viewpoints with the original lighting and in eight novel lighting conditions. For the DTC examples, we use the original lighting in rendering. Error metrics are computed as averages over all images.
blocks.zh:
我们通过两套测试来评估我们的多视角物质重建模式: (1) 一套完全控制的合成试验,有32个实例 2) 从 DTC (Dong等, 2025.) 数据集获取了8个真实的多视图取景.
对于合成装置,我们用从八个角度取出的材料制作出每个3D模型,这些材料与最初的照明和8个新颖的照明条件相同。 对于DTC的例子,我们在渲染时使用原始的照明. 误差衡量标准作为所有图像的平均值计算。

blocks.en:
To account for any tonemapping bias of the baselines, we fit a parametric camera response function (CRF), following Lin et al. (2025) , for each series based on ground truth renderings under the original lighting condition.
Material estimation under unknown lighting is fundamentally ambiguous as observed intensity depends jointly on illumination intensity and material reflectance.
Consequently, the different methods produce materials with different systematic bias in the material parameters, which can be largely reduced with CRF adjustment.
For completeness, we include series without CRF adjustments in our supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our implementation is currently not optimized. Inference is costly, in particular for the multi-view model: 130 s for the 17-view model @2K on a GB300 GPU (see supplement). Recent video model acceleration and distillation techniques offer promising directions for improving efficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们的执行目前没有优化。 推论成本很高,特别是对多视图模型:130 s在GB300 GPU上为17-视图模型@2K(见补充). 最近的视频模型加速和蒸馏技术为提高效率提供了有希望的方向。

blocks.en:
Capturing specular appearance is challenging, and while our approach
improves over previous work in this aspect, careful data curation can likely help. We are also excited about looking closer at neural material representations, which accurately model specular appearance ( Yu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
捕捉外观很困难,虽然我们的方法
与以往这方面工作相比,仔细的数据整理可能有所帮助。 我们也对仔细观察神经物质的表征感到兴奋,这些表征是准确的模型光谱外观(Yu等,2026年).

blocks.en: Wan-2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) operates on patches of 16 × 16 16\times 16 , which is the smallest granularity for attention and RoPE. Consequently, in patches with multiple overlapping texture atlas segments our model lacks the information to distinguish them. Although higher texture resolutions mitigate this issue, patch-aware texture unwrapping, or pixel-space diffusion models are promising directions for future work.
blocks.zh: Wan-2.1(Wan等,2025年)运行于16×16 16\times 16的补丁上,这是注意和ROPE最小的颗粒. 因此,在多个重叠纹理图集部分的补丁中,我们的模型缺乏区分它们的信息。 虽然更高的纹理分辨率减轻了这个问题,但有补丁意识的纹理解围,或像素-空间传播模型是未来工作的有希望的方向.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We show that texture space diffusion models can be powerful tools for material reconstruction and generation, achieving on par or higher quality compared to the state of the art. Operating in texture space ignores the common problems of view consistency or data sparsity, making our method both simple and scalable.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,与最新工艺相比,纹理空间传播模型可以成为物质重建和生成的有力工具,在同等质量或更高质量上实现。 在纹理空间中操作忽略了视图一致性或数据痉挛等常见问题,使我们的方法既简单又可伸缩.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation details

blocks.en: A.1 CRF adjustment
blocks.zh: A.1 通用报告格式调整

blocks.en:
Appearance decomposition is a highly ambiguous task, making quantitative evaluations challenging.
To account for the ambiguity, we fit a parametric camera response function (CRF) and exposure value for all the multi-view methods presented in the paper.
We parametrize the response function using Grossberg and Nayar (2004) and fit it with a rerendering loss ( Liu et al., 2020 ) .
Specifically, for all the available views, we render the object in HDR using the original lighting condition and the predicted materials.
Then, we start an alternating optimization between exposure and CRF fitting, giving a total of 10 trainable parameters (1 exposure and 3 curve parameters for each color channel).
We apply the exposure, then the learned CRF to tonemap the image and compare against the original image using L1 loss.
We tune the exposure for 25 steps, then the CRF parameters for 200 steps and alternate for 20 cycles using learning rate of 0.01.
Following IRIS ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , we apply a monotonicity regularizer with weight of 0.1.
blocks.zh:
外观分解是一项非常模糊的任务,使得定量评价具有挑战性.
为了说明这种模糊性,我们采用了一个参数相机响应功能(CRF)和论文中介绍的所有多视图方法的曝光值。
我们使用Grossberg和Nayar(2004年)来瘫痪反应功能,使其与回落损失相适应(Liu等人,2020年)。
具体地说,对于所有现有的观点,我们利用最初的照明条件和预测的材料,在人类发展报告中使对象成为对象。
然后,我们开始在曝光和通用报告格式配置之间进行交替优化,总共给出10个可训练参数(1个曝光参数和3个曲线参数,每个颜色通道)。
我们应用曝光,然后学习到的通用报告格式来对图像进行定调并用L1损失来与原始图像进行比较.
我们调整了25个步骤的暴露,然后是200个步骤的通用报告格式参数,然后是20个周期的替代参数,使用0.01的学习率。
继IRIS(Lin等,2025年)后,我们施用单调正则剂,重量为0.1.

blocks.en: A.2 Inference scaling
blocks.zh: A.2 推断尺度

blocks.en:
As described in the main text, we are combining our proposed super-resolution model with noise rolling.
The super-resolution model is trained on 512 × 512 512\times 512 input and 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 output resolution, giving 4 × \times upscaling.
To scale this further to handle 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 inputs, we apply progressive noise rolling.
First, we generate the texture in native 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 resolution, then upsample it with nearest neighbor interpolation.
We add noise according to timestep 0.2 and denoise with 50 steps using noise rolling.
In Table S2 we report the runtime cost and peak VRAM usage for these generations.

blocks.en: A.3 Diffusion transformer model
blocks.zh: A.3 分散式变压器模型

blocks.en:
Our input tensor, 𝐈 \mathbf{I} , consists of texture-space views for N N frames, alongside the world space positions and normals, also in texture space. World space positions and normals are quantized to 8 bits per channel and normalized to the [-1,1] range before the VAE encoding, ℰ \mathcal{E} .
The target latent variable, z 0 𝐦𝐚𝐭 \textbf{z}_{0}^{\mathbf{mat}} , is constructed by encoding the reference base color, and HRM (height, roughness, metallicity) as two RGB images using the ℰ \mathcal{E} encoder, then concatenating the encoded images along the temporal dimension.

blocks.en: A.4 3D-aware RoPE
blocks.zh: A.4 3D-意识 RoPE

blocks.en:
A rotary positional embedding (RoPE) which incorporates 3D positions was introduced in RomanTex ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , which replaces a 2D RoPE encoding of pixel x ​ y xy -coordinates
by a 3D-aware RoPE which encodes the 3D world space position. Positional Encoding Field ( Bai et al., 2026 ) proposes another 3D RoPE variant, combining pixel x ​ y xy -coordinates and depth.
The motivation is to improve view consistencies in multi-view generation.
blocks.zh:
RomanTex(冯等,2025年)引入了包含3D位置的旋转位置嵌入(ROPE),取代了像素xy-坐标的2D RoPE编码.
由3D-意识的ROPE编码出3D世界空间位置. 位置编码场(Bai等,2026年)又提出了3D RoPE变体,结合了像素xy-xy-坐标和深度.
其动机是改善多视图生成中的视图组成。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we adapt a variant of this for our texture space diffusion framework, and modify the RoPE (combining pixel x ​ y xy -coordinates, 𝐩 u ​ v \mathbf{p}_{uv} and frame id f id f_{\mathrm{id}} ) of Wan 2.1
to a 3D-aware RoPE encoding (combining a 3D world space position and frame id: 𝐩 x ​ y ​ z + f id \mathbf{p}_{xyz}+f_{\mathrm{id}} ) to inject stronger geometry guidance in our single-view and text-to-material generation pipelines.

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价协议

blocks.en: We evaluate our method using standard image-quality and perceptual metrics. For reconstruction tasks, including material extraction from multi-view captures, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. For generative tasks, such as text-to-material and single-view material generation, we report distribution-based metrics CLIP-FID and CMMD, following common practice.
blocks.zh: 我们使用标准图像质量和感知度量来评估我们的方法。 对于重建任务,包括从多视图取出的材料,我们报告PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS. 对于转基因任务,如文本对材料和单视图材料生成,我们报告基于分布的度量衡CLIP-FID和CMMD,遵循惯例.

blocks.en: All metrics are computed on rendered images with a black background. For reconstruction tasks, we use a rendering resolution of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels to adequately capture high-resolution textures. We use a rendering resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels for the distribution-based metrics, as they rely on CLIP which is limited in resolution (336 × \times 336 pixels for CMMD, utilizing the ViT-L/14@336px vision model and 224 × \times 224 pixels for CLIP-FID). We apply no image processing other than tonemapping, using either the ACES tonemapper or CRF adjustments as indicated.
blocks.zh: 所有度量衡都根据黑色背景的图像计算。 对于重建任务,我们使用1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素的渲染分辨率来充分捕获高分辨率纹理. 我们使用512×512 512\times 512像素的渲染解析度来进行以分布为基础的度量衡,因为它们依赖于分辨率有限的CLIP(CMMD的分辨率为336×\times 336像素,使用VIT-L/14@336px视觉模型和CLIP-FID的分辨率为224×\times 224像素). 我们不采用图像处理方法,而只采用音调图,如上所示,使用ACES音调或通用报告格式调整。

blocks.en: Notably, the black background makes scores dependent on scene scale. For synthetic benchmarks, we use a camera path where the object bounding sphere is maximized but guaranteed to fit on screen. For the DTC ( Dong et al., 2025 ) dataset, we pick representative views of a revolution where the object is large on screen.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,黑色背景使得分数取决于场景尺度. 对于合成基准,我们使用一个相机路径,在这个路径中,限制对象的球被最大化,但保证能与屏幕相接. 对于 DTC (Dong et al., 2025) 数据集, 我们选取具有代表性的观点 革命中物体在屏幕上很大。

blocks.en: Our protocol differs from the Stanford-ORB methodology ( Kuang et al., 2023 ) adopted by DTC ( Dong et al., 2025 ) and LSRM ( Li et al., 2026b ) . The Stanford-ORB protocol uses a lower resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels and erodes the reference image mask by 5 × 5 5\times 5 pixels, inserting black background in both reference and rendered image in the eroded regions. Furthermore, they use two variants of PSNR, one (PSNR-L) applied to srgb-remapped clipped (to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) linear color values, and another (PSNR-H) applied to linear values which are clipped to [ 0 , 4 ] [0,4] . In both cases, the images are normalized using a mean color normalization approach ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) . The set of evaluation views are also different. As a consistency check, we evaluated the LSRM materials using the Stanford-ORB metrics pipeline and obtained scores comparable to those reported in the original paper.
blocks.zh: 我们的协议与DTC(Dong等,2025年)和LSRM(Li等,2026年b.)采用的斯坦福-ORB方法(Kuang等,2023年)不同. 斯坦福-ORB协议使用512×512 512\times 512像素的下分辨率,并用5×5 5\times 5像素侵蚀了参考图像掩码,在参考和被侵蚀区域都插入了黑色背景并渲染出图像. 此外,它们还使用了PSNR的两个变体,一个(PSNR-L)被应用于srgb重制剪接(至[0, 1] [0, 1])线性颜色值,另一个(PSNR-H)被应用于被剪接到[0, 4] [0,4]的线性值. 在这两种情况下,图像都采用平均颜色正常化的方法实现正常化(张等,2021年). 这套评价意见也不同. 作为一致性检查,我们利用斯坦福-ORB计量管道对LSRM材料进行了评估,并取得了与原论文所报相当的分数.

blocks.en: For the single-view to material and text to material experiments, we run all algorithms with known reference geometry. Like our method, VideoMat and VideoMatGen require known geometry, and the released code of Trellis.2 (their “PBR Texture Generation mode”) and Hunyuan3D 2.1 (the Hunyuan3DPaintPipeline), both support PBR material generation with known geometry. We use the same conditioning image for all algorithms.
blocks.zh: 对于材料的单视图和文字到材料实验,我们用已知的参考几何来运行所有算法. 和我们的方法一样,VideoMat和VideoMatGen需要已知的几何学,发布的代码Trellis 2(他们的"PBR纹理生成模式")和Hunyuan3D 2.1(Hunyuan3DPaintPipeline)都支持有已知几何学的PBR材料生成. 我们对所有算法都使用相同的条件图像。

TEXGen ( Yu et al., 2024 ) introduced generative diffuse material creation in texture space, guided by an additional

from finetuned 2D diffusion priors. For a fair comparison, we compute metrics for our method and TEXGen in the single-image to material setting

Note that our method solves a more complex task: predicting full PBR materials from a shaded view, while TEXGen predicts only albedo maps from a demodulated view. Our method produces more coherent materials and we score higher in all metrics computed on the evaluation set of 2048 relit views.

blocks.en: Our upscaler network mainly serves as a tool that we use along with noise rolling ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ; Vecchio et al., 2024 ) for higher resolution results, and is designed similarly to previous work. Current generative pipelines typically use ESRGAN ( Wang et al., 2018 ) to either directly upscale material parameter textures ( Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025 ) , or to upscale rendered images and rely on differentiable rendering tricks to propagate the results to the material parameters, one notable example is PBR-SR ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . We report quantitative results in Table S4 , as expected our upscaler performs on par with previous work, with differences mainly being due to training dataset and our method being intended for texture space use. Notably PBR-SR ( Chen et al., 2025a ) performs better on roughness and metallicity parameters, which is due to their expensive multi-view differentiable rendering optimization step.

We ablate against both the standard Wan 2.1 RoPE, and Wan 2.1 RoPE+ G buf G_{\mathrm{buf}} where the world space position and normals are provided as VAE encoded guide images.
In Figure S6 we show attention maps for a particular query point at selected layers at diffusion denoising step 15 (out of 50). As expected, our 3D-aware RoPE attends more strongly to local regions in world space, even if they are distant in texture space.
In Figure S7 , we show the attention maps for all layers, and note that this behavior is apparent through all layers of the network. The Wan 2.1 RoPE+ G buf G_{\mathrm{buf}} variant shows similar behavior but only in the middle layers of the network. Table S5 ablates the RoPE variants on text to material generation for our full synthetic dataset. Our 3D-aware RoPE shows a small but consistent improvement in quantitative metrics.
This ablation uses the same model architecture and parameter count as the main experiments, but generates material textures at 512 × 512 512\times 512 rather than 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 resolution, which is why the results do not completely match the main evaluation in Table 2 . Figure S8 shows an additional example scene from our synthetic dataset, where we run the same text to material generation with four different seeds. The Wan 2.1 RoPE results show higher variance, with the model struggling to separate geometric components in texture space.

blocks.en: Figure S9: Generation - Text to material. Materials from our generative method, conditioned on a text prompt and the input geometry (the UV mask, world space positions, and surface normals). We compare against VideoMat ( Munkberg et al., 2025 ) and VideoMatGen ( Hasselgren et al., 2026 ) . Without any image guidance, our model still produces semantically meaningful materials for all examples.
blocks.zh: 图S9:生成-文本到材料. 以文字提示和输入几何学(紫外线口罩、世界空间位置和地表常态)为条件, 我们比较VideoMat(Munkberg等,2025年)和VideoMatGen(Hasselgren等,2026年). 没有任何图像指导,我们的模型仍然会为所有例子制作有目的意义的材料.

blocks.en: In Figure S9 we show examples of materials generated from text conditioning only. Even though our method operates in disjoint texture space, the 3D RoPE encoding provides enough information to generate semantically meaningful materials. Texture space discontinuities also often coincide with material borders (e.g. the “Marshall” text) which can sometimes benefit our model over the image space alternatives.
blocks.zh: 在图S9中,我们仅显示文本调制生成的材料的例子。 尽管我们的方法在不连接的纹理空间中运行,3D RoPE编码提供了足够的信息,可以生成精密有意义的材料. 纹理空间的不连续性也往往与物质边界(例如“Marshall”文本)相吻合,有时这对我们的模型比图像空间替代品有利。
